The '''Vorkutan Great Reorganization''' was the 1927 municipal and industrial restructuring associated with [[Gorodovaya Syndikalizm]] in [[Vorkutangrad]].

== Reorganization ==

Old source material says the city was divided into twelve industrial-residential districts. Each district was centered on a major industrial complex and governed by a worker kollektiv that coordinated both production and community services.

The reorganization also replaced the old central administrative district with a large workers' assembly hall, creating a symbolic and practical center for city-wide syndicalist coordination.

== Legacy ==

The Vorkutan model became a reference point for later theories of industrial democracy and urban planning. Its influence on [[Orderism]] and [[Unified Orderism]] should be treated as intellectual influence unless more canon confirms direct organizational links.
